source_name: Положення про порядок здійснення авторизації діяльності надавачів фінансових платіжних послуг (Постанова Правління НБУ № 217 від 07.10.2022) та Положення про реєстрацію платіжних систем (z0348-14)
why_relevant: The legal instruments that define what the registers must contain, the nine statutory categories of payment service provider, and the fields recorded on authorisation. Essential for building a correct schema and for knowing which register segments must exist.

source_name: Мін'юст / ДП «Національні інформаційні системи» (НАІС) — публікація ЄДР у формі відкритих даних
why_relevant: Documents the January 2026 restoration of ЄДР open data and names Мін'юст and ДП «НАІС» as the publishing channels alongside data.gov.ua — the pointer needed to locate the authoritative bulk dumps and to understand what remains restricted for security reasons.

source_name: НБУ — портал portal.bank.gov.ua (REST API technical instructions / statistical portal)
why_relevant: Separate NBU portal subdomain hosting REST API v.1.1 technical instructions; indicates a second, portal-based data delivery channel distinct from bank.gov.ua/NBUStatService and worth probing for additional statistical endpoints.

source_name: НБУ — Грошово-кредитна та фінансова статистика (monthly MFS bulletin, PDF series)
why_relevant: Monthly monetary and financial statistics release; the authoritative series for готівка в обігу (cash in circulation), M0-M3 monetary aggregates and banking-sector balance-sheet aggregates. Predictable file-naming pattern MFS_YYYY-MM.pdf makes it trivially harvestable as a time series.

source_name: НБУ — Звіт з оверсайту платіжної інфраструктури (Oversight Report series)
why_relevant: Annual oversight report on payment systems, settlement systems and payment-infrastructure service operators: registered payment systems counts, systemically important systems, SEP volumes, and criteria for significant infrastructure operators. Contains structural detail on the payment infrastructure that the quarterly card releases omit.

source_name: НБУ — Огляд банківського сектору / Banking Sector Review (quarterly PDF series)
why_relevant: Quarterly analytical review of the banking sector with commission/fee income, net assets, and cash-flow seasonality — the context layer that explains why card and terminal volumes move. Predictable Banking_Sector_Review_YYYY-MM.pdf naming supports time-series harvesting.

source_name: НБУ — Методологічний коментар: Грошово-кредитна статистика
why_relevant: The methodology note behind the monetary/financial statistics: definitions, sector coverage (100% of banks operating in Ukraine), compilation and dissemination frequency. Essential to avoid mis-reading cash-in-circulation and aggregate series, and to justify comparisons over time.

source_name: НБУ — Річний звіт / NBU Annual Report (PDF series)
why_relevant: Annual report consolidates payment-infrastructure development indicators, cash-circulation operations and financial-inclusion measures into audited, citable year-end figures — a reliable backstop when quarterly series are revised, and it carries strategy signals (e.g. cash-at-checkout, inclusion banks).

source_name: НБУ — прес-релізи про ринок платіжних карток (news/all quarterly card-market releases)
why_relevant: Recurring quarterly narrative releases with headline numbers: POS terminal counts, ATM counts, trade-and-service outlets accepting cards, cashless share by count and by value. These are the texts that all Ukrainian media re-quote, and they carry the interpretation the raw XLSX does not.

source_name: НБУ — перелік системно важливих, соціально важливих та важливих платіжних систем і важливих технологічних операторів
why_relevant: Annually published designation list naming the systemically/socially important payment systems and important payment-service technology operators (e.g. СЕП, Visa, Mastercard, PrivatMoney, NovaPay, «Фінансовий світ», ACD Processing, Ukrainian Processing Center, TAS Link). A short, ranked, named list of the actors that actually move volume — high-signal for prioritising later scouting.

source_name: NBU news item: NBU, Visa and Mastercard interchange memorandum
why_relevant: Primary documentation of the regulator-scheme interchange memorandum that sets the rate-reduction schedule; anchor document for the whole interchange-regulation storyline and for dating rate steps.

source_name: NBU news: first PROSTIR–UnionPay co-badged card in Ukraine
why_relevant: Documents the national scheme's cross-border co-badging strategy — the mechanism by which PROSTIR gains international acceptance without Visa/Mastercard. Directly on-cell for cross-border infrastructure.

source_name: Держстат — методологічні положення «Обстеження умов життя домогосподарств»
why_relevant: Defines exactly how cash vs non-cash expenditure categories are constructed — essential to avoid misreading Держстат series as payment-instrument statistics.

source_name: Держстат — обстеження «Витрати і ресурси домогосподарств України»
why_relevant: The household budget survey is the only official source separating cash outlays, non-cash subsidies, in-kind receipts and deposits/securities purchases at household level — a direct read on cash-vs-cashless household behaviour independent of the NBU.

source_name: Індекс цифрової трансформації регіонів України (Мінцифра, щорічний звіт)
why_relevant: Region- and hromada-level scores for digital infrastructure, digital economy and digital skills — the only public sub-national grid usable to model regional differences in card/POS adoption where NBU data is national or oblast-coarse.

source_name: FinAwards (Minfin.com.ua) — nominee lists and winners
why_relevant: Nine-year-running Ukrainian financial-market award. Nominee long-lists are effectively a census of active banks, PSPs, acquirers and fintech apps by category (online acceptance, offline acceptance, fintech tech), and applicant self-descriptions often disclose merchant counts and transaction volumes.

source_name: Minfin / PSM7 / Fintech Insider reporting on banking-association positions (association-position aggregator route)
why_relevant: Ukrainian financial media reliably reproduce association position papers that the associations themselves publish only as PDFs or member letters — e.g. the July 2026 report that the banking association urged against cutting card interchange to EU levels, arguing card income sustains payment-system continuity in wartime. A practical fallback when association sites throttle or gate.

source_name: Доступ до правди — запити на публічну інформацію до НБУ (напр. «Довідник банків України»)
why_relevant: FOI platform whose published request threads contain NBU's own answers about where register data lives and in what format — and provides a legal channel (запит на публічну інформацію) to obtain register extracts that are not published online.

source_name: Power Payment Summit: Ukraine–Europe Bridge
why_relevant: Newer summit convening regulators, IFIs, banks, PSPs and payment schemes on Ukraine–EU payment infrastructure convergence (SEPA/EPC). Speaker rosters reveal which institutions are working on cross-border payment integration projects.

source_name: PSM7 (payspacemagazine UA) — review of Ukraine's processing centres
why_relevant: Ukrainian fintech trade outlet that periodically inventories processing centres and payment-tech vendors with comparative figures. Excellent snowball hub: single articles enumerate the vendor field and link to each actor's site.

source_name: ПриватБанк — Річний (інтегрований) звіт
why_relevant: Ukraine's largest issuer/acquirer publishes an integrated annual report containing card counts, ATM estate, POS/merchant terminal counts, Privat24 users and acquiring turnover — the single richest bank-level payments dataset in Ukraine.

source_name: IMF Ukrainian-language publications & Memorandum on Economic and Financial Policies (МЕФП)
why_relevant: The MEFP / Letter of Intent are published in Ukrainian by the NBU and MoF and contain the authorities' own commitments on financial-sector and payments reform — the local-language authoritative version of IMF conditionality.

source_name: EBRD news & Ukraine country pages (annual investment totals, PFI deals)
why_relevant: Announces headline volumes and named partner banks (e.g. PrivatBank guarantees), giving early signal of which Ukrainian banks are receiving capacity to invest — a leading indicator for equipment and infrastructure demand.

source_name: Асоціація рітейлерів України (RAU) — e-commerce / E-Meeting industry track
why_relevant: RAU convenes e-commerce market-player roundtables (E-Meeting series) on responsibility and regulation of online trade, where online-payment friction and acquiring terms are debated. Event write-ups name the participating merchants and PSPs — pointer value on top of content value.

source_name: Finance.ua news — FinAwards category breakdowns (offline/online acquiring providers)
why_relevant: Category-level award coverage identifies the competitive set in offline/online payment acceptance — directly relevant to POS acquiring market structure — and repeats vendor-supplied merchant/transaction figures.

source_name: IFC pressroom — Ukraine financial sector partnerships (incl. NBU MoU)
why_relevant: Announcements of IFC–NBU cooperation and digital finance programmes give the policy framing and timing that later appear as procurement or regulatory change.

source_name: Mind.ua — аналітика витрат рітейлу на карткові розрахунки / еквайринг
why_relevant: Retail-side economics of card acceptance (interchange/еквайринг cost) is the direct driver of merchant preference for cash; Mind's openmind pieces are written by retail and payments practitioners and often quote chain-level cash/card shares not published elsewhere.

source_name: PwC Ukraine — Voice of the Consumer / consumer preferences survey
why_relevant: Big-4 consumer survey for Ukraine with payment-method and channel questions; useful cross-check on cash-vs-card mix at retail point of sale and on wartime behavioural shifts.

source_name: Checkbox — certified payment-terminal partner blog (Printec / Castles S1F2)
why_relevant: Ukraine's PRRO (fiscalisation) layer means POS terminal models must be certified with software providers like Checkbox. Certification announcements reveal which terminal makes/models are actually entering the Ukrainian market and which distributors are pushing them — an indirect but timely POS installed-base signal.

source_name: data.europa.eu — profile of Ukraine's data.gov.ua open data ecosystem
why_relevant: EU-side description of the Ukrainian portal's scale (~80k datasets), governance and technology — useful for assessing reliability and harvestability of the whole open-data channel, and a bridge to EU-side mirrors.

source_name: Euromoney Awards for Excellence — Ukraine country write-ups
why_relevant: Award submissions force banks to hand over acquiring turnover, terminal counts and growth rates; the published write-ups therefore surface bank-supplied payments metrics (e.g. PrivatBank acquiring UAH 1.06trn in 2024, UAH 973bn via stationary merchant terminals) that appear in no Ukrainian-language document.

source_name: Global Business for Ukraine (GB4U) — Finance Access Survey
why_relevant: Co-publisher with EBA of the MSME finance-access survey; hosts the survey landing page independently, giving a second retrieval path and sometimes fuller methodology than the EBA news item.

source_name: Printec Ukraine LLC — filed management report (financial statements PDF)
why_relevant: A vendor's own statutory management report is a rare quantitative window on the Ukrainian ATM/POS supply market: revenue by line, customer concentration, market commentary. Establishes that the group publishes local-entity filings, which is a repeatable annual series.

source_name: Tietoevry Banking — Ukraine open-banking campaign and UPC partnership
why_relevant: International core/card vendor with an explicit Ukraine go-to-market page and a named partnership with UPC to run Ukraine's open-banking platform. Vendor campaign pages of this kind carry regulatory-deadline framing and client counts that indicate where bank IT spend is heading.

source_name: UTG Company — споживча поведінка українців (retail/mall consultancy research)
why_relevant: Retail real-estate consultancy publishing shopper-behaviour studies for Ukrainian retail; occasionally reports payment-method and basket data by format, useful for cash mix by retail channel (mall vs. convenience vs. market).

source_name: Райффайзен Банк Аваль — застарілий домен звітності ex.aval.ua
why_relevant: Legacy Aval reporting archive holding pre-rebrand annual reports with historical card/ATM/POS series; valuable for time series back to the 2000s-2010s.
